documents.summary: Pods entered CrashLoopBackOff after a ConfigMap change removed a required environment variable; reverting the configuration fixed it.
Checkout errors and timeouts rose while the payments database refused connections; the calling service was healthy.
A campaign doubled the request rate; CPU saturated and latency rose until replicas were added.
A container was OOMKilled at its memory limit under normal load without memory growth; raising the limit resolved it.
